function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web. Use it for news, recent events, prices, opening hours, or any fact you are not sure about. Returns titles, URLs and short snippets. To read a result in full, pass its URL to web_fetch.

query.description: Search words, as you would type them into a search engine.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Read a web page and return its main text, shortened if it is long. Use it on a URL from web_search results or one the user gave you.

url.description: Full http(s) URL of the page.
